questions.question: How do we reconcile 'preferred Feb 15–18, 2027 vacation days' (3 nights) with '1–2 weeks in Las Vegas between Feb 15 and Mar 23, 2027'?
questions.answer: Treat Feb 15–22, 2027 (Mon–Mon, 7 nights) as the primary baseline — it captures all preferred Feb 15–18 vacation days while satisfying the 1–2 week duration! If extending to 10–14 nights, Feb 15 – Mar 1, 2027 avoids the mid-March NCAA tournament spike on Center Strip.
questions.discovery_steps: Confirm exact PTO count (7 vs 10 vs 14 nights) with both travelers before Dec 2, 2026 so refundable Cyber promo rates can be locked.

questions.question: Which week inside Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 is actually cheapest on official resort booking engines (resolving Q-06 / F-29)?
questions.answer: It splits cleanly by Strip geography! On CENTER STRIP & DOWNTOWN (all 8 Caesars resorts + Downtown Grand + Encore), Feb 15–22, 2027 is 3%–28% CHEAPER than Mar 14–21, 2027 because NCAA March Madness First Weekend (Mar 18–21) surges sportsbook hotels (Caesars Palace $1,407 vs $1,967 pre-tax; LINQ $539 vs $679; Encore $3,738 vs $4,970). On NORTH STRIP near LVCC (Hilton/Conrad/Crockfords at Resorts World, Fontainebleau, and Wynn Tower), Mar 14–21, 2027 is 4%–19% CHEAPER because a Feb 16–17 convention sells out Conrad and elevates North-Strip towers.
questions.discovery_steps: Choose Feb 15–22, 2027 if staying Center Strip (Caesars Palace, Planet Hollywood, Horseshoe, Flamingo, LINQ) or Encore; choose Mar 14–21 (or Mar 16–23) if staying at Fontainebleau or Resorts World.

questions.question: When is the best booking window to purchase Feb–Mar 2027 Las Vegas hotel rooms?
questions.answer: RIGHT NOW — Nov 27 to Dec 4, 2026 (Cyber Monday / Black Friday week)! Official engines are running steep refundable promotions with hard deadlines: Fontainebleau Bleau Friday (FRBF26: 35% off + $0 resort fee + $350 dining credit) expires Dec 2, 2026; Wynn/Encore Cyber Exclusive (up to 20% off + $300 resort credit, 72h free cancel) expires Dec 4, 2026; Caesars Cyber Monday Early Access offers 48h free cancellation with $0 due today.
questions.discovery_steps: Book a refundable 7-night reservation before Dec 2 / Dec 4, 2026, then re-check rates 30 days before arrival (Jan 16, 2027) and rebook free if any winter sale drops lower.

questions.question: What are the exact 2027 tasting-menu prices for the 3 unpriced MICHELIN-Starred restaurants (2★ Joël Robuchon, 1★ L'Atelier, 1★ é by José Andrés)?
questions.answer: Their official MGM / Cosmopolitan web pages intentionally omit dollar totals, so we keep them blank rather than citing third-party food blogs.
questions.discovery_steps: 1) Call MGM Grand Fine Dining Concierge at 702.891.7925 (Joël Robuchon) & 702.891.7358 (L'Atelier) to request current PDF prix-fixe pricing. 2) Open ebyjoseandres.com/las-vegas on Tock exactly 90 days out (~Nov 17–25, 2026 for Feb 15–22 stays!) to view live prepaid ticket prices and secure two of the 9 counter seats.

suggestions.title: If booking Wynn/Encore for Feb 15–22, book Encore Resort King ($534/nt) instead of Wynn Resort King ($677/nt)

suggestions.title: Buy RTC passes in the RideRTC app (2× 3-Day + 1× 24-Hr = $48/adult) and skip unlimited Monorail unless riding 11+ times
suggestions.detail: Two 3-day Strip & All-Access passes ($20×2) plus one 24-hour pass ($8) cover all 7 days on BOTH The Deuce AND Route 203 (Chinatown) / Route 202 (Flamingo) for $96/couple.
